description: Train a conservative per-user action router over M7, R1, R1-plus, and the V2.2 global blend.
notes: The router trains on validation users and evaluates once on test users.
The target action is the per-user oracle best action on validation labels.
Users with tied oracle labels are excluded from training by default to reduce label noise.
Success is measured against V2.2 global blend, not only fixed experts.
